uncertainties.note: Voice-only taunt before the Blue Hawk of Giganos (Meio Plato) is visually identified in 2621-2624. Speaker not named yet at this point in the table, so no identity was assumed for these three rows; 'that one' (romaji: yatsu) kept gender-neutral.
Unnamed allies reassuring/reluctant about fighting Meio Plato. No speaker identity or gender assigned; 'he'/'him' refers to Meio Plato, already named by the preceding rows, not an inferred subject.

Source pronoun (romaji: yatsu, 'that one/that guy') kept as gender-neutral 'that one' rather than 'he', since the referent (revealed one row later as Meio Plato) is not yet named at this point in the table.

Squad/waypoint callsigns Yamabuki, Orange Vermilion, Red, Blue, Point R are not in any glossary file and have no apparent wiki source; treated as ACE3-original color-based unit callsigns for the Shirahime defense force and translated literally. See glossary proposal file.

Source term (romaji: Giganos-gun, 'Giganos military') rendered 'Giganos army'/'Giganos-army' by analogy with existing corpus phrasing ('Giganos forces', batch_01426); no row here uses a book/color tag around it.
